namespace: Control composite detail dialog Clear action
default: false; Clear is hidden unless explicitly enabled on the selected cell, tuple, or position
effect: shows Clear for an object or array draft; Clear empties the draft without removing its containing value, and Apply commits it
precedence: selected cell or tuple-position local boolean overrides tuple-level local boolean; flat and removed namespaced global values do not expose Clear; readonly, disableRemove, empty values and restrict/schema prevention still disable the action

namespace: Control composite detail dialog Clear label
effect: relabels the selected composite dialog's Clear action when that action is shown
precedence: selected cell or tuple-position local value overrides tuple-level local value; a translation key resolves first and otherwise displays literally; flat and removed namespaced global labels do not apply
